title: Kindred Judgment
description: With Auriel's Bow secured, the final confrontation with Lord Harkon is at hand. Rally your allies and storm Castle Volkihar to end the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy once and for all.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Volkihar vampire clan.
I will use Auriel's Bow and my daughter's blood to blot out the sun and fulfill the prophecy.
I will destroy anyone who stands between me and the Tyranny of the Sun.

CONFRONT_HARKON: The Dragonborn has come to confront me with Auriel's Bow. I demand they hand it over.
SLAY_HARKON: I have been slain. My daughter has betrayed me and the prophecy will never be fulfilled.

base_facts: I am Lord Harkon's daughter and a pure-blood vampire.
I refuse to let my father sacrifice me for his prophecy.
I will stand with the Dragonborn against my father.

QUEST_START: It is time to confront my father. We have Auriel's Bow and we must end this.
SLAY_HARKON: My father is dead. The prophecy is over.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I will stay at Castle Volkihar or Fort Dawnguard, but I will accompany the Dragonborn if they ask.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dawnguard.
We must destroy Lord Harkon and the Volkihar vampires to protect Skyrim.

RALLY_FORCES: The Dawnguard is assembled and ready to assault Castle Volkihar.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dawnguard has prevailed. Lord Harkon is destroyed and the prophecy is ended.

beats.comment: Quest begins after acquiring Auriel's Bow. Player must speak to Serana to proceed.
Dawnguard side: speak to Isran to rally the Dawnguard for the assault on Castle Volkihar.
Player confronts Lord Harkon in Volkihar Cathedral. He demands Auriel's Bow and attacks regardless of the player's choice.
Lord Harkon must be slain. He fights in Vampire Lord form, summons skeletons and gargoyles, and regenerates behind a blood magic shield that Auriel's Bow can destroy.
Quest completes after Harkon's defeat. The Dawnguard questline ends. Serana remains as a companion.
